{{Name|Fir Wax|1}} }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a type of [[Crafting|craftable]] weather totem that is used to increase the chances that the next in-game day will be {{Weather inline|wind}}y. It has no effect in {{Season|Winter}}, but otherwise, it follows the same behavior as the vanilla [[Stardew:Rain Totem|Rain Totem]], i.e. it will only changed for the area where the totem was activated. If the next day's weather ''can'' be altered then it will be. Some days are guaranteed to be rainy, for example, Spring 3 year 1. And festival days and the first day of the season cannot be altered. [[Stardew:Weather|Weather - notes]] ==Recipe Source== The crafting recipe is instead learned overnight after players reach [[Stardew:Foraging#Foraging Skill Skill|Foraging Skill]] level 9. ==Gifting== {{PAGENAME}} is a universally '''hated''' item. ==Bundles== {{PAGENAME}} is not used in any bundles. ==Quests== {{PAGENAME}} is not used in any quests. ==Tailoring== {{DyePot|brown}} When used in dyeing, {{PAGENAME}} produces a brown color. ==History== * v.1.15: Introduced
